question_text: On an average, rain falls on 12 days in every 30 days. Find the probability that rain will fall on just 3 days of a given week.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the probability of rain on exactly three days of a week — what n, p and q are, and which term of the binomial formula you use.
insider_note: n comes from the week — n = 7, never 30 or 12; those two numbers only make p = 12/30 = 2/5, and 'just 3 days' means exactly 3, a single term with r = 3.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write n, p, q
steps.margin_note: First mark. Success = rain on a day, p = 12/30 = 2/5, q = 3/5. A week is 7 days, so n = 7. 'Just 3 days' means exactly 3, so r = 3.
lines: Success = rain on a day: p = 12/30 = 2/5
⇒ q = 1 − p = 3/5. A week has n = 7 days.
X = number of rainy days in the week;
X is binomial with n = 7, p = 2/5,

recall.must_convey: That p = 12/30 = 2/5, q = 3/5, n = 7 and the required probability is P(X = 3).
accept: p is twelve by thirty which is two by five, q is three by five, n is seven and we need P of X equals three
rain on a day has probability two fifths, a week is seven trials, exactly three successes
p two by five, q three by five, n seven, r three
p twelve by thirty ante two by five, q three by five, week lo seven days, P of three kavali
binomial with n seven and p two fifths

steps.why: Seven days with the same chance of rain is a binomial situation. The word 'just' fixes r = 3 exactly, and reducing 12/30 to 2/5 keeps the powers small.
common_mistakes: Using n = 30 or n = 12 instead of 7.
Taking p = 3/7 from the question's '3 days of a week'.

steps.label: Find P(X = 3)
steps.margin_note: Second mark. P(X = 3) = ⁷C₃ q⁴ p³ = 35 · (3/5)⁴ · (2/5)³. Keep it as powers: (35 · 3⁴ · 2³)/5⁷. The evaluated value 22680/78125 is optional.

steps.why: Exactly three rainy days out of seven is the r = 3 term. ⁷C₃ = 35 counts which three days, q⁴ covers the four dry days and p³ the three wet ones — every factor has a meaning.
common_mistakes: Putting the power 4 on p and 3 on q.
